SELECT fish_date_season AS season,
  CAST(floor(fish_date_doy/10)*10 AS INT) AS doy_decile,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) AS n_boats,
  SUM(yt) AS total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers,
  SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE cls='day_1_5' AND fish_date_season IN (1,2)
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
